## My Study Plan

I made this small dataset from my current MDS weekly schedule and my own rough estimates of study time.

Data source: I created the dataset myself. [View the data](study_plan.csv).

```{python}
import pandas as pd

study = pd.read_csv("study_plan.csv")
study
```

## Average Daily Study Time

First, I calculated my total study time for each day and the average across the week.

```{python}
daily_hours = study.groupby("day")["hours"].sum().reindex(
    ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]
)

daily_hours.mean()
```

## Study Time by Course

I also checked how many hours I planned to spend on each course during the week.

```{python}
course_hours = study.groupby("course")["hours"].sum()
course_hours
```

## Daily Study Time

```{python}
#| label: fig-daily-study
#| fig-cap: "Estimated study hours for each day of my MDS week"
#| warning: false

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.bar(daily_hours.index, daily_hours)
plt.ylabel("Hours per Day")
plt.xlabel("Day")
plt.show()
```

My plan gives me about the same total study time on each study day. The course totals are also fairly balanced, although the actual time can change depending on assignments and quizzes.
